en: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon.

ja: 都上りの歌。ソロモンによる。

p.src: 1  Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

ja: が警戒してもむなしい。
en: Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.
u.src: 1  Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

p.src: 2  It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

ja: くまで起きていて、 労
en: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
u.src: 2  It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

p.src: 3  Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

en: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
u.src: 3  Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

p.src: 4  As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

en: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.
u.src: 4  As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

p.src: 5  Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

en: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
u.src: 5  Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.
